translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Nigu Nqvi Lr Israel Naglqlzku Yawe
Nabz kx nzngrnelzngr Jerusalem mz nzangiongr.

content.text: Naglqlz-zvzku Yawe,
Murde nide Gct rgu.
X nigu kxnzawz nedeng na-amrlueku nide
Mz nzkrka'-krmu mz Mangr-nzangiongr x makoa ngrde.
Na-amatqku nide murde mrlz-esz'ngr.
X na-angrlvz-ngrgu nide nivz lrde.
Murde mcpxle nqvi lr Jekop, nigu lr Israel,
Mz nzngini-krgu leplz nedeng.
Krlzku kx Kxetu rgu, Yawe, nide Gct kc tqmyatxlz-esz'ngr,
Myaszlzle kxnzmncng mzlilxlr amrlx.
Vz-nqblq-txpwzle me pnz drtwrde mz da kx alele
Kxmule-esz' mz bongavz, nrlc, prla, x me boo-ngrng.
Wz-ngrde zbo nzvzdz-krdr mz lclxlr mz bongavz,
X bzlrpc nzvzmi-krm trlipu le.
X batrpzle nzwqkr nenq.
Sc tqnibqtile ncblo kx ayrnrngr Ijipt,
Kr neng leplz x kr neng animol.
Rwzngr da kxnzkctipxng kxkqlu mrlcde,
Mz nzayrplapx-krde king rdr x kxnzetu nedeng.
Aovxiole lr mrkzbleng kxkqlu
Mz nznibqti-krde king kxnzxplr-zlwzng.
Krlcng King Sihon, King Og, x kzdu-kzng king
Kcng tzaclveng mz drtc' Kenan.
X drtc' nyzdrng katimleng bagu,
Nigu lr Israel, da kc tqwai nzpi-krmlele bagu.
Nqmq kr Yawe tqyc tqyc.
X nzrkrlzngr drtqde tqvzpe tqvzpe.
Yawe sa napipxbzle mz leplz nedeng kxnzvz-rbrng o trtingr,
X sa na-aodu-zvzle nidr.
Kxnzmnc-mrbrng nzangiolr mqngr da kx nzlz,
Kcng tzwzngr ncblo mz silvz x gol.
Mqngr da kxnzlz lcng naodr x mztr ycbz,
A' trnzycmneung x trnzrmcung da.
Nradrtqdr x nctqdr ycbz,
A' trnzxlrung da x trnzycmini-kzung.
Leplz kcng tzrwz-ngrng nzapu-kzlr mqngr lcng.
Murde nznabung, trnzobqung, nradrtqdr ngq, x trpnzngr nzlungr badr.
A' Nigu nqvi lr Israel, naglqlzku Yawe.
X nimu pris, nqvi lr Eron, na-amrlue-kzamu nide.
X nimu kxnzawz nedeng, nqvi lr Livae, na-amatqamu nide.
Nigu amrlx kcng tzamrluelr nide, na-angrlvzku nide.
Na-angioku Yawe Jerusalem, mz Newz Saeon.
Naglqlz-zvzku Yawe.
